_note: What you see: Archive a completed decision, with confirmation and an entry in the history.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Een afgerond besluit archiveren, met bevestiging en vermelding in de geschiedenis.
De raad stelt de Subsidieregeling sportv: The council adopts the Grant scheme for sports clubs 2026. Clubs with youth members get a fixed contribution per youth member and a one-off contribution to make their clubhouse more sustainable.
De Subsidieregeling sportverenigingen 20: Adopt the Grant scheme for sports clubs 2026.
Een budget van 380.000 euro beschikbaar: Make a budget of 380.000 euro available from the sports programme.
De regeling laten ingaan op 1 oktober 20: Let the scheme take effect on 1 October 2026.
Het besluit gaat naar het archief. Het b: The decision goes to the archive. It stays findable in the decision register, but the text and attachments can no longer change.
